v35-25.candidate: and Jeremiah lamented over Josiah. All the male and female rulers spoke a lament over Josiah to this day. They made it an ordinance for Israel, and behold, it is written among the laments.
v35-25.close: and Jeremiah lamented over Josiah. All the male and female rulers spoke a lament over Josiah to this day. They made it an ordinance for Israel, and it is written among the laments.

v35-27.candidate: and his deeds, first and last—behold, they are written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah.
v35-27.close: and his deeds, first and last, are written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah.
